# HEM v0.6.2b19 — Per-device closed-door Eco and door-aware start coordination

## Individual device settings

- **Eco when door closed and room unoccupied** is now an independent per-controller toggle under **Device Settings → Windows, doors and ventilation**. It retains the original physical safety gates: 120-second verified closure, verified vacancy, Home, no sleep/arrival priority, verified closed windows, safe temperature and RH. Unknown, missing or moved door sources never authorize Eco.
- **Device start coordination across open doors** is now a per-controller dropdown. Options: inherit previous per-door policy, observe only, delay conflicting starts, coordinate eligible starts. Only a verified linked interior OPEN door and an already-running eligible peer can cause a bounded new Automatic-start wait. A CLOSED door does not synchronize starts. The existing three-minute limit and manual/PID/sleep/away/urgent bypasses remain.
- Both controls appear only when the device's own room has a configured, native, same-Area door sensor. The editing path retains immutable controller identity, revalidates ownership under the existing settings lock and never sends device commands.
- The **Connects to room** dropdown stays in **Room Settings**. Door purpose, report timeout, measured energy and source selection also remain there. Existing HA entities, user automations and saved room/door preferences are preserved; old room Eco and contact coordination are hidden from HEM's Room Settings presentation only.
- Translated labels and helpful descriptions are provided in Greek, English and German. No physical device, sensor registry or Home Assistant instance is changed by publication.

## Verification

- New simulated backend door-policy tests cover per-device ownership, inheritance, source loss/movement and no physical device commands.
- New real-card Chromium regression covers exact switches/selects and service targets at 320px/390px/760px in EN/EL/DE and no-door hiding. Existing door settings and all regression gates must pass before release.
